title: A diagram is a file
text: Point d2-live at a .d2 file and it keeps the picture open next to your work, redrawn on every save — from your editor, a script, anything.
code: Solid: the engine moves on by itself. Dashed: waits for an outside event.
start: "" {shape: circle; width: 18; height: 18; style: {fill: "#334155"; stroke: "#334155"}}
PAYMENT_PENDING: "PAYMENT_PENDING\nwaits for the card network" {class: pause}
CART_LOCKED -> PAYMENT_PENDING: "ask the payment provider" {class: sync}
# The provider answers asynchronously; a decline ends the order with nothing to undo.
PAYMENT_CAPTURED -> SHIPPED: "hand to the carrier" {class: sync}

title: Point at a state
text: Click it on the diagram and its declaration lights up in the code, every other mention dimmer. Put the cursor on a line and the picture answers back.

title: Rename it
text: Type a new name and every transition that mentions it follows: the declaration and the two transitions change, nothing else in the file moves.

title: Wire a transition
